name: strip_strictly_empty_unprovenanced_paragraphs
integration_point: After durable save of the raw provider response and after materialization of the derived candidate, before the existing production structural validator runs.
applies_only_when: no attribution, citation, or other significant editorial metadata
no other object depends on the paragraph identifier
removal does not modify remaining paragraphs
never: delete a paragraph that contains an idea
delete a paragraph that contains evidence
delete a paragraph with significant metadata
convert a semantic failure into a structural success
after_strip: run the existing production structural validator
reject the candidate if the validator fails
